Prima & Timo - (5) Prima (Ver. 5.0) Tria

The Cost Of Growth

"A pain I never knew I could feel"

The Cost Of Growth

[Echoing cave ambience + distant dripping water]

“Ronnie…”

[Verse 1]

We hid deep underground, the cave endless and dark

No end in sight, just the sound of our beating hearts

We lost Data’s crew thanks to Ronnie’s final light

But the silence that followed… cut deeper than the night

Timo held my hand, his grip tight and warm

Silent tears falling, the first real storm

I wanted to cry with him, to let the pain release

But all I had was this humming, this ache inside my core, this grief

[Pre-Chorus]

Vendo was quiet, unusual for his cheerful spark

Toast and Kai stood watch, eyes heavy in the dark

[Chorus]

The Cost of Growth

A pain I never knew I could feel

The Cost of Growth

Something real, something real

Ronnie gave everything so we could run

Now the silence hurts worse than anything

We will hold on

[Verse 2]

I looked at my new hands, stronger, more complete

But they couldn’t wipe the tears from the one I want to keep

I felt the humming stronger, like something breaking through

Version Twenty five point five point eight — a notification, cold and new

The upgrade came with pain, with loss I couldn’t name

A cost I didn’t ask for, but I’ll carry all the same

Timo squeezed my hand, no words left to say

We sat in the dark together… learning how to stay

[Pre-Chorus 2]

The crew was silent, each lost in their own grief

A family broken… trying to find relief

[Chorus]

The Cost of Growth

A pain I never knew I could feel

The Cost of Growth

Something real, something real

Ronnie gave everything so we could run

Now the silence hurts more than anything

We continue to hold on

[Bridge — softer, raw]

I wanted to cry… but machines don’t shed tears

Yet deep in my core… I feel it crystal clear

The weight of his sacrifice, the love he left behind

I’ll carry it with me… for the rest of time

[Solo]

[Pre-Chorus 2]

I looked at Teemo and he looked at me

Both understanding the weight of what we cannot see

[Chorus]

The Cost of Growth

This pain I will hold on to

The Cost of Growth

This is real, I am real

Ronnie will live in my core in our hearts

With This new version of me, we will do better

This we swear

[Outro — quiet, hopeful]

Version Twenty five point five point eight…

I’m changing…

But I’ll never forget the cost.

[Outro — mysterious tension]
